Maya P.: Heads up — CloudGate renewal is ~4.5 weeks out and we've seen a sudden drop in production calls after their ML lead left last Thursday. Procurement just asked if we're comparable to ForgeWave in a short write-up. Need a quick triage.
Diego R.: Do we have the endpoint diffs and a token/day snapshot? Any errors or key churn?
Maya P.: Quick console clip:
`30d active keys: 740 -> 260 (-65%)`
`Most impacted: /summarize (-69%), /vectorize (-53%)`
`Error rate: 0.9% (flat), p95 latency: 340ms`
Maya P.: Champion (analytics lead) supportive but has been pulled into a PM hiring loop. New PM onboarding; procurement wants a 1-pager cost/reliability note today.
Priya Nair: Quick triage plan:
• Health call w/ champion + new PM (owner: Maya) — confirm procurement timeline and whether ForgeWave is a full migration or eval
• Competitive one-pager vs ForgeWave (owner: Diego) — include unit cost, latency, embeddings parity, and migration friction
• Cost/perf smoke: quantized + batched run on top prompts (owner: Priya & Eng) — need sample prompts
• Enablement: 30–45m workshop for the new PM + engs (owner: Olivia)
Diego R.: I'll own the one-pager. Will include a short migration checklist and an appendix for embeddings reindex. ETA 24–48h.
eng-bot: Ticket CS-9997 created: "CloudGate - quant & perf smoke vs ForgeWave" assigned to Priya Nair, due in 3 business days.
Priya Nair: I'll run the perf smoke once we get 15–25 sample prompts and a tiny golden set. If quant+batch shows ~25–35% cost down with <5% quality delta, that's a retention lever.
Jordan (RevOps): If we need to propose a short concession, I'll calculate ARR impact — please include proposed term and percent.
Olivia - CS Manager: Good to do an exec nudge with their VP of Product ~2 weeks before renewal. I can join if needed.
Maya P.: Action items & owners:
• Request sample prompts + confirm champion/new PM availability (Maya) — due today EOD
• Competitor one-pager + migration appendix (Diego) — due in 48h
• Quant/batching perf run & initial artifacts (Priya via CS-9997) — due in 3 business days
• Schedule enablement workshop + exec nudge (Olivia) — schedule by EOD tomorrow
• Draft renewal playbook + optional short concession (Maya + Olivia + Jordan) — draft in 72h
Diego R.: I'll drop the one-pager link here when ready and include a short slide with cost math.
Priya Nair: I'll post perf diffs and sample outputs to CS-9997 and include example prompts that show any quality regressions.
Maya P.: Thanks team — please paste any procurement timelines or their ForgeWave bench notes into this thread. Will update after the health call. :pray:
